ShortDescription.Value: Unofficial compatibility update of Configurable Elevated Road: pillar interval, edge length, steepness, no-pillar and no-height modes, all configurable in-game.

Publish.LongDescription:
**This is an unofficial continuation of "ConfigurableElevatedRoad" by Jimmyokok.** The original mod is no longer maintained and stopped loading after a game update. This version rebuilds it against the current game assemblies and keeps the same features, options layout and settings file. All credits for the original design and implementation go to the original author.
## Feature
* Configurable pillar interval (20m-800m). * Optional no pillar construction mode. * Configurable maximum edge section length (20m-800m). * Optional no height limitation construction mode, that lifts the height restriction to 1000m. * Optional no steepness limitation construction mode. * One-click options to restore vanilla/mod default settings. * The above settings all appear in the game setting menu and are recommended to be configured in-game. The changes you've made **immediately take effect** and persist in the configuration file.
## Note for existing users
* This is a **separate mod** with a different id than the original. Do not enable both at the same time - disable the original one first. * Your existing settings are kept: same settings file, same options layout.
## Important Notes
* This mod affects save games, as the road/bridges/tracks you've built are just there. * Setting the maximum edge length to extreme values would possibly cause weird behaviors, e.g. extremely difficult to delete a piece of road. Please be cautious when playing with the maximum edge length. * Feedback and bug reports are welcome - please use the link below.
## Technical
* Modified System: None
## Credits
* Original mod "ConfigurableElevatedRoad" (ModId 77597) and its implementation: Jimmyokok. * Compatibility maintenance for current game versions: jayzhu.
Publish.ChangeLog: v1.0.0 * First release of this continuation, published as a NEW mod: the original mod (ModId 77597) is unmaintained and cannot be updated from another account. Disable the original before enabling this one - settings and features are identical. * Rebuilt against the game 1.6 assemblies. The mod no longer fails to load with "MissingMethodException: AssetDatabase.LoadSettings". * Vanilla prefab data is left untouched unless "no pillar" mode is enabled, so newer vanilla section/placement data is no longer overwritten. * Added support for the waterway-crossing sub-object placements added by newer game versions.
